_: Canonical constants for the workstream-S stat design (docs/world/76-stats-progression.md §116-129). Phase 10c ports this file to packages/game-core/src/stats/data/.

health._: maxHealth = attrCoefficient*(Str+End) + level*(levelBase + End/levelEnduranceDivisor). Continuous and retroactive.

stamina._: max = base + endCoefficient*End; regen/s = regenBase + regenAgiCoefficient*Agi after regenDelay.

carry._: capacityKg = base + strCoefficient*Str. Str 50 = 180 kg = today's sandbox capacity.

burdenTiers._: calibrated by the sim so the reference kit is mid and a full endgame plate kit is fat until Strength grows

rollTiers._: Equip-load tiers change roll distance, recovery AND invulnerability frames (Dark Souls 1's 13/11/9-frame behaviour). This is not stat-gating a feel verb (the DS2 Adaptability mistake): the tier is a visible, freely-chosen consequence of what you decided to carry.

mitigation._: mitigation = AR / (AR + constant + damageCoefficient*incomingDamage). Big hits still punch through, but less steeply than the first pass so that top-tier armour is worth wearing when blows are huge.

softRequirement._: Shortfall d below an item requirement: never blocks, costs stamina. (The recovery penalty went with the recovery band - owner veto, round 2.)

breath._: seconds = base + athleticsCoefficient*Athletics + enduranceCoefficient*End; unlimited for water-breathers.

vastei._: per qualifying use = perUse * worthiness * (1 + effSkill/skillDivisor)

levelUp._: 10 major/minor ranks = one pending level. miscRankRatio is the 3:1 tail: a rank in a miscellaneous skill, or in any skill already sitting at 100, is worth a third of a level-credit. That tail is PER SKILL and ungated - the earlier reading (3:1 only once every major and minor had reached 100) threw away about two use-points in five and was the single largest cause of the campaign model's stalled levelling.

difficulty._: Global lethality knob. 1.0 is the designed 'normal'. Exposed at play time as a difficulty setting and used by the balance harness; it multiplies incoming enemy damage only - it never touches the world's populations, loot or gates (0004).

armourClassRating._: What a class of armour is worth per piece before material and skill. Light protects less and weighs much less; heavy is the opposite. Applied to the raw slot rating.

sneakAttack._: Sneak openers. Skyrim's shape (Skyrim:Sneak - dagger x6/x15 with Assassin's Blade, one-hand x3/x6 with Backstab, bow x2/x3 with Deadly Aim) rebuilt as six Sneak-skill bands so it needs no perk economy. Melee stays ahead of ranged because closing to knife distance unseen is the hard part - but the bow ladder was extended to x8 (owner, round 3: stealth-archery is a build we want to be genuinely strong).
sneakAttack.note: applies to the first blow on an actor that has not detected you; a missed opener is simply an ordinary attack. A bow opener at Sneak 100 is the single biggest hit in the game outside a dagger assassination, which is the intent.

climbing._: Acrobatics governs climbing (module 76 §122). Stamina drains while you hold the wall; a mantle at the top costs a lump. Burden multiplies the drain, which is what makes a looted-up character unable to climb out.
climbing.note: you may hang still and recover restOnHoldRegenFraction of normal stamina regen; falling costs the fall-damage rules in module 76 §122

worthiness._: A blow worth this fraction of the target's health is a full use-point (module 76 §120.2). Chip damage on a sponge is worth almost nothing, which is the anti-grind rule. Damping stops a long fight being a skill mill - but at 6 connects worth 0.35 it went too far: a real boss fight ended up teaching you less than a rat did, which is backwards. Relaxed to 8 connects at 0.55. Worthiness and damping scale COMBAT AND DEFENCE only; blocks, casts, brews, locks, persuasions, repairs and travel have no magnitude to scale by (see data/rules-argonia.json).
